🌊 FREE 6-Passenger Golf Cart | Private Pool | Walk to
Beach
Luckie Days – 120 Dalton Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL
32459
Bring the whole family to Luckie Days, a beautifully designed 4BR / 4BA Seagrove Beach
cottage that sleeps 10 and is just a 5-minute walk to the beach and Eastern Lake.
Perfect for two families traveling together, this thoughtfully designed home offers a primary suite
with private bath on each floor, plus an additional bedroom and full bath on each level — giving
everyone space and privacy while still enjoying time together.
⭐ Why Guests Love Luckie Days
✔ Private backyard pool
✔ FREE 6-passenger golf cart
✔ Walk to beach access (5 minutes)
✔ Quiet street near Eastern Lake
✔ Bonus upstairs living area for kids
✔ Gas grill & outdoor shower
✔ No hidden fees — pricing includes all fees
✔ All linens laundered after every stay (Complete Clean Linen Program)
Pool heating available Oct 1 – May 1 for $50/day
🏡 The Space
The open main living area features comfortable seating, a dining table for 6, breakfast bar seating
for 4, and a fully equipped kitchen — perfect for family meals after a day at the beach.
Step outside to your private backyard oasis with:
• Refreshing pool
• Lounge seating
• Covered porch
• Gas grill
• Outdoor shower
Upstairs, the bonus landing area with TV and sofa creates the perfect kids’ hangout space.
Washer and dryer included for your convenience.
🛏 Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 10)
First Floor
• Primary Suite: King bed + private bath (walk-in shower)
• Guest Bedroom: Queen + twin trundle
• Full bath (shower/tub combo)
Second Floor
• Primary Suite: King bed + private bath (walk-in shower)
• Guest Bedroom: Queen + twin trundle + private bath
Ideal layout for two families — privacy when you want it, togetherness when you don’t.
📍 Prime Seagrove Location
Walk to Eastern Lake Beach Access in minutes.
Eastern Lake is one of South Walton’s rare Coastal Dune Lakes — a unique natural
phenomenon found in only a handful of places worldwide, including New Zealand, Australia,
Madagascar, and South Walton, Florida. These special lakes mix fresh and saltwater, creating
calm areas perfect for paddleboarding, kayaking, and wildlife viewing. When the lake outfall
opens to the Gulf, children of all ages enjoy playing where the gentle current meets the shoreline.
You’re also just steps from the 30A Trailhead, offering miles of scenic biking and walking paths.
🍽 Restaurants Within 1/2 Mile
Walk, bike, or take the golf cart to popular nearby spots:
• Café Thirty-A
• The Perfect Pig (Seagrove)
• Angelina’s Pizzeria & Pasta
• Canopy Road Cafe
• Local Cantina
• Old Florida Fish House
• Turbo Coffee
From fresh seafood and beachside dining to pizza nights and morning breakfast, everything is
close enough to skip the car.
Important Policy
Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian (1 adult over 25 per 4
guests under 25).
Luckie Days combines location, layout, and lifestyle — private pool, walkable beach access, golf
cart convenience, and one of 30A’s most desirable neighborhoods.
📅 Prime dates fill quickly — reserve your stay today!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
